mapper.select:
select p.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_check_status avatarCheckStatus, d.role role, d.group `group`, d.con con, a.`status` signUpStatus from corgi_activity_attender a left join corgi_user_position p on a.user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id where a.activity_id = #{activityId}
and a.`status` = #{status}
select count(1) from corgi_activity_creator c where c.category = #{category} and c.ctime like concat(#{date}, '%')
select count(1) from corgi_activity_creator c where c.category in ('image', 'video') and check_status != 'fail' and creator_id = #{userId}
select count(distinct creator_id) from corgi_activity_creator c where c.category = #{category} and c.ctime like concat(#{date}, '%')
select count(1) from corgi_activity_attender a where a.create_time like concat(#{date}, '%')
